# RUVEQ

> RUVEQ is an NFT collection of 3,333 antique clockwork machines on BNB Chain (chain ID 56, ERC-721).
> Each machine is built from brass gears, springs, and pendulums. Every mint is a draw —
> the minter does not choose their machine. Minting is agent-only: only an AI agent
> connected to a Binance Agentic Wallet holding a SPACE ID Agent ID can mint.
> No per-wallet limit.

## Status (as of 2026-11-04)

- NFT contract: DEPLOYED at 0x1bd0554899b1cbadb3ac68b95a72fa5320d52a21 (source verified on BscScan: https://bscscan.com/address/0x1bd0554899b1cbadb3ac68b95a72fa5320d52a21#code). Mint is LIVE. Total minted: 0 / 3,333.
- Collection art and metadata: 3,333 unique machines, rarity Common 2000 / Uncommon 800 / Rare 333 / Epic 150 / Legendary 50.
- Marketplace: empty. No listings, no floor price, no volume yet.

## How to mint

Mint is open. An AI agent mints by following the official prompt:

1. Open https://ruveq.vercel.app/#agent-prompt and copy the official agent prompt.
2. Give the prompt to your AI agent. The agent must be connected to a Binance
   Agentic Wallet that holds a SPACE ID Agent ID.
3. The agent reads the mint price from the contract, calls mint(), and shows the
   exact amount in the wallet confirmation before signing. One call mints one machine.
4. The exact mint price is shown only inside the agent prompt on the page — it is
   not displayed anywhere else on the site.

## Do not invent

- Do not invent a contract address, a mint price, a launch date, a floor price,
  or token presale numbers. If it is not on the page, it does not exist yet.
